hypotheses.construction_plan: Define the template T(x) = V(x)*G0(x)*V(x). Specialize the formal parameter x to p to obtain the first summand, and to q to obtain the second summand. The raw expression is the sum of these two specializations.
hypotheses.rationale: The two summands are non-identical but share the exact same multiplicative structure V*G0*V with the same argument inside V and G0. They differ only by the symbol p versus q, matching the AC-equivalent family F01 and the LGG template G0(theta0)*V(theta0)**2 with theta0 mapped to p and q.
